name: print-social-black-and-orange-creative-agency-post-with-role-icon-tiles
title: Black and orange 'Creative Marketing Agency' post with role icon tiles and halftone orange bar
whatItIs: A square black post with a big white and orange headline overlapping a photo of a smiling woman in an orange sweater holding a tablet, set on an orange halftone bar, plus four dark tiles with orange icons (Graphic Designer, General Manager, Account Executive, Research Staff) and an orange 'Register now' button.
whatItMeans: Energetic and clear; icon tiles make roles scannable while the orange ties to the model's sweater.
techniques: Let the headline overlap onto the photo.
Present roles as icon tiles in a 2x2 grid.
Back the photo with a halftone-dotted colour bar.
Match the accent to the subject's clothing.

vocabulary.definition: A square with an icon and short label.
Text or shapes crossing into another element.
